newsitem.title: INDIA: India rupee gains against dlr on large export sale.
newsitem.headline: India rupee gains against dlr on large export sale.

text.p: The rupee gained against the dollar on Tuesday on large dollar sale by Indian exporters, dealers said.
The rupee touched a high of 35.80 against the dollar compared to the opening level of 35.84/85, they said.
The RBI bought dollars in the spot market but its intervention was overwhelmed by a large dollar sale, a chief forex dealer at a leading foreign bank said.

The rupee gained against the forward dollar on initiatives by the Reserve Bank of India to lower interest rates, dealers said. October dollars were quoted at 1.07/1.10 rupees in latest trade compared to the opening level of 1.14/1.16 rupees.
